title: A page-item write runs the past-ruling check before the item posts
why: Page item 475 asked the owner a question his Nov 9 pick already answered; no check runs on a page-item write, so it reached the page.
note: Incident (02:37-02:52 CST Nov 10): the coordinator sent triage a question about the merge tool's read flags; triage posted it as page item 475; the owner's Nov 9 13:09 CST pick (lane-lint-runs-comment-check) already answered it; the Stop hook's past-ruling check caught it in the coordinator's report, after the item posted. Fix: the ArtifactData write of a new open item runs the same past-ruling check the Stop hook uses (rule past-ruling) and refuses an item a past ruling answers. Related: past-ruling-on-send (ready; judges the send to the page writer). Second incident 13:25 CST Nov 12: triage posted page item 613 (round 3 only after a failed round 2) citing item 402 a (Nov 8), though R9 (owner 15:44 CST Nov 10, corrected 16:07 CST, step rounds-rules-one-record) already ruled "i never wanted round 3 if it passed earlier". The write passed the past-ruling check because R9 lives on the record branch (restart-plan, step notes), not in main's decisions. Owner 13:26 CST: "this was long since already established". Fix: the check also reads the restart plan's R-rulings and plans/owner-rulings-*.md on the record branch, newest first. Red first on item 613's text. Retrospective 13:29 CST Nov 12: R9 is at plans/restart-plan.md line 350 on branch restart-plan; main's copy of the plan lags, so the check reads origin/restart-plan, not main. Retrospective asks (coordinator 14:30 CST Nov 12, also sent to lane pick-ack-past-ruling #2932): read origin/restart-plan and later page answers before citing; cite the later ruling; word a hit as "a past ruling to weigh".
